tests.policyNote: Driver-free guards intentionally inject errors; only real gameplay logs are used for zero-validation-error qualification.

limitations: Bounded unmeasured stock RGB, artistic shading retained, scalar optical defaults; no generated/replacement artwork.
Terrain texture pixels/UVs/normals are original, but palette modulation is not reconstructed from already-lit vertex colors.
Coastal cells below maximum tide/wave bound stay conservative legacy hit fallback, including dry low-lying coastal terrain.
Only existing catalog-qualified raster receivers replace independently separated ambient; additional v3 and terrain sources are not new receivers.

Known hits currently reflect direct sunlight, not their full skylight or multi-bounce response; GI is substantially darker overall than legacy ambient in these regions. Positive bounce isolation is not total-GI brightening or radiometric ground truth.
Partial static stock coverage; cutouts, impostors, unsupported lighting modes, mixed atlases, arbitrary deformation and damaged geometry remain fallback.
Original base-mip hit sampling, finite range, one diffuse bounce, no indirect specular; foliage aliasing and estimator noise remain.
Existing mission camera sweeps, not player-input responsiveness or exhaustive weather/night qualification.
